entities.summary: Marco De Marchi was an Italian naturalist and businessman. He studied the hummingbirds of Argentina and conducted studies on the aquatic life of Lake Maggiore. He was also a philatelist and philanthropist. He bequeathed his villa in Varenna for the hydrobiology institute of the University of Milan.
